facts.business: Afcom Holdings Limited is an India-based international air cargo company providing dedicated air freight transportation services, specializing in time-sensitive and high-priority cargo such as pharmaceuticals, perishables, electronics, and industrial goods across ASEAN and Middle Eastern markets through its airport-to-airport connectivity model.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Afcom is focused on creating stronger connections and opening access to new markets through fleet expansion, route optimisation, operational excellence and deeper partnerships.
guidance_or_targets.value: Exploring long-haul opportunities and newer markets including Australia and Europe

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: (1) Lease accounting under Ind AS 116 involving significant judgement in lease term, incremental borrowing rate for USD-denominated leases, variable lease payments, maintenance reserves, supplementary rent, and foreign exchange retranslation. (2) Provision for aircraft re-delivery/return condition obligations of ₹967.30 lakhs as at March 31, 2026, involving significant estimation of expected outflows, escalation, discount rates, timing of re-delivery, and treatment of maintenance reserves.

key_risks: Significant judgement in lease accounting under Ind AS 116 for USD-denominated aircraft leases
Estimation uncertainty in aircraft re-delivery/return condition provisions
Foreign exchange risk on USD-denominated lease liabilities
Dependence on strategic partnerships with GSSAs, freight forwarders, and airlines
Operational risks in time-sensitive cargo transportation
Regulatory and compliance risks in international air cargo operations
facts.related_party_note: Payable to related parties of ₹24.48 lakhs as at March 31, 2026 (nil in prior years). Outstanding dues of creditors other than micro and small enterprises include related party amounts.
